# Kinship/Cryptic Relatedness

Primarily interested in two sets of flagged cases:

1.  Documented 1st degree relationship (Expected kinship coefficient Phi = 0.25) is higher than inferred relationship (Inftype = 2nd, 3rd or 4th)

2.  1st degree or twin relationship (Dup/MZ, FS, PO) inferred but not documented

```{bash}
king -b ~/sniparV2_unipar_plink/Affy550K_qc1.bed \
    --related \
    --degree 1 \
    --prefix ~/sniparV2_unipar_plink/KING_Output/Affy550K_qc1
```

```{r Kin/Kin0 Review}
## 189,259 relationship pairs
## Error 0.5: 5,659 / Error 1: 6,704
kin <- read.table("Affy550K_qc1.kin", header = T)

## 78 relationship pairs of interest
kin_check <- kin %>% 
    filter(Error %in% c(0.5, 1)) %>% 
    filter(InfType %in% c("Dup/MZ", "FS", "PO") | Phi >= 0.25) %>%
    select(FID, ID1, ID2, Phi, Kinship, InfType, Error)
write.table(kin_check, file = "kin_check.txt", quote = F, row.names = F)

## 10 undocumented 1st degree relationships between pedigrees
kin0 <- read.table("Affy550K_qc1.kin0", header = T)

## See corresponding excel file for adjustments (kin_adjustments.xlsx)
kin <- read.table("kin_check.txt", header = T)
kin0 <- read.table("Affy550K_qc1.kin0", header = T)

## Drop list: 
## 1 sib from ALL sets of ITWINS and others selected via manual review
kin_drop_list <- read.csv("Kin_Update/kin_drop_list.csv")

## Kin adjustment table (see kin_adjustments.xlsx):
## Combination of within-ped (kin_adjust tab) and between-ped (kin0_adjust tab)
## adjustments as determined following manual review. 
kin_adjust_list <- read.csv("Kin_Update/kin_adjust_list.csv")
```

```{r Create Update Files for PLINK}
## Use kin_adjust_list to update PEDNO/FID. Note that FID is updated for ALL those with shared PEDNO 
## when a respondent previously classified as a singleton is added to the pedigree
## New FID format: PED_{OG Fam PEDNO}_{OG Singleton PEDNO}
kin_update_peds <- plink_ped_ref %>% 
    select(FID_OLD = V1, IID = V2) %>%
    right_join(kin_adjust_list %>% select(FID_OLD, FID_NEW), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    filter(FID_OLD != FID_NEW) %>%
    mutate(OLD_IID = IID) %>%
    select(OLD_FID = FID_OLD, OLD_IID, NEW_FID = FID_NEW, NEW_IID = IID)

## Extract list of parental ID adjustments from kin_adjust_list
kin_update_pars <- kin_adjust_list %>% select(FID = FID_OLD, IID, PAT = FSHARE_NEW, MAT = MSHARE_NEW)

## Final kinship adjustment files to use with PLINK
write.table(kin_drop_list, "Kin_Update/kin_drop.txt", quote = F, row.names = F)
write.table(kin_update_pars, "Kin_Update/kin_update_pars.txt", quote = F, row.names = F)
write.table(kin_update_peds, "Kin_Update/kin_update_peds.txt", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

```{bash Update PLINK Files}
plink1.9 \
  --bfile Affy550K_qc1 \
  --remove Kin_Update/kin_drop.txt \
  --make-bed \
  --out Affy550K_qc2

plink1.9 \
  --bfile Affy550K_qc2 \
  --update-parents Kin_Update/kin_update_pars.txt \
  --make-bed \
  --out Affy550K_qc3

 plink1.9 \
  --bfile Affy550K_qc3 \
  --update-ids Kin_Update/kin_update_peds.txt \
  --make-bed \
  --out Affy550K_qc4
 
## KING confirmation: "No cryptic relatedness (up to the 1-degree) is found."
king -b \
    ~/sniparV2_unipar_plink/Affy550K_qc4.bed \
    --related \
    --degree 1 \
    --prefix ~/sniparV2_unipar_plink/KING_Output/Affy550K_qc4
```
